title: 4200 WEST 28TH STREET, A.K.A. 4200-4206 WEST 28TH STREET; BOARD FILE NO. 260070
text:
[C. PUBLIC NUISANCE HEARINGS regarding the abatement of vacant buildings or structures that are]
4200 WEST 28TH STREET, A.K.A. 4200-4206 WEST 28TH STREET; BOARD FILE NO. 260070
  C.D.: 10 (Councilmember Heather Hutt); West Adams – Baldwin Hills - Leimert Planning Area

  STAFF MEMBER:  Zeydi Stewart
  BUREAU/DIVISION:  Code Enforcement/Vacant Building Abatement

  SUBJECT:

  The Department of Building and Safety (LADBS) requests that the Board of Building and
  Safety Commissioners (BBSC) determine that the subject property, consisting of four dwelling
  units configured as two two-story duplex dwellings with a detached accessory garage building,
  constitutes a public nuisance due to the property having been repeatedly breached and
  continuously maintained in an unsecured condition, thereby facilitating unauthorized entry and
  occupancy.

  ACTION BY THE BBSC IS NOT APPEALABLE.
